description: This file is a migration script for the OrangeHRM system, specifically for version 4.3. It defines database schema changes, data insertions, and access permission setup related to the Marketplace feature within the HRM system.

classes.name: Migration
classes.description: A database migration class extending AbstractMigration, responsible for applying schema updates, inserting data, and configuring permissions for the OrangeHRM system, specifically related to marketplace features in version 4.3.

methods.name: up
methods.description: Executes the migration: inserts module data, permissions, configuration entries, and creates the marketplace addon table if it doesn't exist.

methods.name: getVersion
methods.description: Returns the version string '4.3' indicating the migration version.
